Sub-national Trend Analysis · Admin2 (Raion) level

Ukraine Conflict Dashboard: Raion Sub-national Trend Analysis

Raion-level (admin2) breakdown of the same real ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data) export as the Overview and Trend Analysis pages, 1 January 2022 to 7 August 2026: 351,530 events, 275,662 fatalities across 35 oblasts and 222 raions. Raions are assigned by a point-in-polygon spatial join against admin2 boundaries (not a name-string lookup). Pick an oblast below to see its raions; the cumulative-toll chart always shows the full history regardless of the date filter.

Raion trends

Raion trend comparison (small multiples)

Every raion of the selected oblast on its own scale, so lower-volume units aren't flattened by a much larger unit's totals on a shared axis - no truncation, even for an oblast with many raions. Switch the metric above; granularity, date range and event-type filters (in the toolbar) apply to every panel. Click a panel to isolate that unit elsewhere on the page; click again to clear.
Cumulative toll

Cumulative toll to date, by raionFull history

Running total since 2022-01-01 for every raion of the selected oblast. Respects the event-type filter but intentionally ignores the date-range filter, so the total is always the true cumulative figure. The 5 raions with the highest total fatalities are drawn bold; every other raion stays visible, drawn thin - nothing is hidden, even for an oblast with many raions. Click a line or legend entry to isolate that unit.
Year-over-year

Year-over-year period comparison

Each selected year plotted across the full calendar year (Jan–Dec). The shaded band marks the highlighted period set below (by calendar month, applied identically to every year shown regardless of chart granularity). Sums all raions of the selected oblast by default; scopes to a single raion when one is isolated (small multiples / cumulative chart / lethality bar / table). Event-type filter (in the toolbar above) applies; the date-range filter doesn't, since this chart always compares full calendar years.

Highlighted-period totals are always summed at month resolution (whichever full calendar months the picked dates span), reapplied to every year shown - a deliberate simplification from the oblast-level Trend Analysis page's exact day-of-year alignment, to keep this page's data volume manageable across many oblasts and raions. When "Annual" is selected the whole calendar year is the period (shown as bars), so there's no separate highlighted sub-range.

Lethality

Lethality rate by raion: fatalities per recorded event

Total fatalities ÷ total events per raion of the selected oblast, for the currently selected date range and event type, ranked highest to lowest. A time-series view per raion was not used here (like the oblast-level Trend Analysis page), since many overlapping lines would be unreadable at this scale, especially for oblasts with many raions: this ranked view keeps every raion comparable at a glance. Click a bar to isolate that unit.

Raions with zero events in the current filter are omitted (an undefined rate, not a zero one).
